## Background

Add NVIDIA-NeMo/teams/automation to Autobot approval eligibility, as requested.

## What changed

Append `approval.enabled: true` and `approval.eligible_teams: [automation]` to `.github/autobot/review-config.yml`, using the requester-supplied configuration contract.

## Details

Preserve the existing comment-mode automatic reviews and ready-for-review trigger. No product code, dependencies, workflows, or other permissions change.

## Tested

- Exact policy content and unchanged review settings: passed.
- Single-file scope and `git diff --check`: passed.
- Cryptographic signature, sign-off, merge-tree equivalence, and remote head: verified.
- Product/GPU tests: excluded; no product consumer reads this policy.
- Repository-wide lint/CI and external controller behavior: unverified. Controller source is inaccessible under session policy.

files.patch:

   on: status_change
